title: Select all squares with art
summary: A fake reCAPTCHA whose image challenge is a client-minted Suprematist composition; VERIFY only ever reshuffles, so the machine can never confirm what art is.
mechanism: A pixel-faithful reCAPTCHA image-challenge readymade whose canvas-generated Malevich tiles reshuffle on every Verify click and never pass, staging the reverse-Turing test as an unwinnable authentication of art.
references: Google reCAPTCHA / Luis von Ahn (the reverse-Turing test as web readymade)
